Koch Law Firm Larry A. Koch, P.A., doing business as Koch Law Firm, is a private law practice in Chanhassen, Minnesota, serving companies, executives and families across Minneapolis and the Twin Cities metropolitan area. The firm was founded in 1993 by Larry A. Koch, J.D., LL.M., an attorney with more than thirty years of experience in business law and estate planning.The firm acts as outside general counsel to mid-sized and small companies. Its business practice covers business and securities law, mergers and acquisitions, management buyouts and rollovers, venture finance, the formation and governance of corporations, LLCs and partnerships, family limited partnerships, intellectual property counseling and licensing, trademark management, commercial contracts, manufacturing, distribution and supply agreements, and commercial real estate and oil and gas leases.For business owners, executives and high-net-worth individuals, the firm provides asset protection and estate planning: wills, revocable and irrevocable trusts, powers of attorney, health care directives, probate avoidance and probate administration, business succession planning, and executive employment and deferred compensation arrangements.Before founding the firm, Larry A. Koch was a partner at Maslon Edelman Borman & Brand and served as a judge advocate in the United States Air Force. He is licensed to practice in Minnesota and North Dakota.The firm is deliberately small. Clients work directly with the attorney, without handoffs between departments.
